POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

----
